name: 飞书 / Feishu
tagline: Documents, tables, and messages through your own Feishu app
description: Use the official Lark/Feishu MCP server with your own application ID and secret. The server acts with the permissions granted to that application; it does not inherit every user document or chat. Personal-user access requires a separate user OAuth login in the official CLI.
